mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fpComment(fp_seq, fpc_id, fpc_content, fpc_date) VALUES(#{fp_seq}, #{fpc_id}, #{fpc_content}, #{fpc_date})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fpComment WHERE fp_seq = #{fp_seq} AND fpc_seq = #{fpc_seq}
mapper.select: SELECT fpComment.*, users.us_profile, users.us_nick FROM fpComment, users JOIN users ON fpComment.fpc_id = users.us_id WHERE fp_seq = #{fp_seq} and fpc_id = us_id ORDER BY fpc_seq DESC
